description.value: Sisto's Pub has anchored the Hatzic neighbourhood of Mission since 1978, earning a reputation as a hidden gem and home-away-from-home for locals. Part of the Springs Group chain, it serves classic, large-portioned pub food with in-house dining, patio seating, and a seasonal back lawn with lawn games. Weekly events include Music Bingo, Karaoke, Family Feud, and Trivia nights, making it a lively stop for cyclists looking for a full meal and evening entertainment.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at springsgroup.ca/sistospub/ is fully accessible and confirms Sisto's Pub is an active, open neighbourhood pub at 34555 Vosburgh Avenue, Mission, BC V2V 6R5 (phone 604-814-1394), contradicting the OSM community tag of Chilliwack. The website explicitly states takeout is available ('open for in house and patio dining as well as take out') and the pub has a back lawn and patio, but no mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the content. The OSM record carries no address or phone, so both are taken from the website with no OSM value to compare against.
